title: Alpine Midnight Miniature Express
summary: A tilt-shift Three.js model railway on an oak bench where a green-and-brass tank engine hauls teak coaches across a seven-arch viaduct.
description: An interactive Three.js / WebGL2 model railway and 30-second short film. The fictional Falkengrat line sits on an oak modelmaker's bench as a green-and-brass tank engine hauls three teak passenger coaches and a rear observation car out of the west tunnel and over a seven-arch viaduct under tilt-shift optics.
